description: Verified Canadian institution domains for Canadian Scam Shield. Categories reflect impersonation patterns most commonly seen in CAFC-reported scams.

schema.domain: Apex domain (no protocol, no subdomain, no path). Matching should also accept www. and known subdomains.
schema.name: Official organization name
schema.category: Used to tailor warnings (e.g. 'cra_impersonation' triggers when a non-canada.ca page mentions CRA refunds)
schema.official_url: Canonical URL to direct users to in warnings
schema.high_value: true if this org is a frequent impersonation target — used for stricter lookalike scoring
